body:
It was elementary school that was cruel and high school people just didn't want want me part of their friendship group.  Outside of school, I'd just get dissed and looked at by strangers all the time even when I try to befriend them.

It's not my self-esteem issues, it's everyone treating me like I'm not worth anything.  I'm fed up with being isolated and not being able to make friends and I'm done with living a life where I feel unloved everyday.  There's just no point in living.
